summary: Read a list of integers and a non-negative integer k. Decide whether two different positions store the same value and the absolute gap of their position numbers is at most k. Write true when such a pair exists, and write false otherwise. Equal values farther apart than k do not qualify. When k is 0, no pair of different positions can satisfy the gap, so the answer is false.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
